in_marathi.name: Bhooshit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhooshit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhooshit means 'one who brings prosperity and is fortunate'. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhushan', meaning 'ornamented'.

in_bengali.name: Bhooshit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhooshit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhooshit means 'one who brings prosperity and is fortunate'. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhushan', meaning 'ornamented'.
